mods.name: Plants vs. Zombies Multiplayer
mods.summary: Online co-op for up to 4 players in Lawn Tycoon, a new endless mode where you walk the lawn as Crazy Dave, share the sun and money, and buy your way from one lane to five.
mods.description:
Plants vs. Zombies Multiplayer adds Lawn Tycoon, an endless co-op mode for up to 4 players. Every player walks around the lawn as their own Crazy Dave (each a different colour, with their name over his head) and plants on the tile they're standing on, and everyone shares the same sun and seed bank. You start in the front yard with one lane and only the Peashooter. Every zombie you kill pays out, the money is shared by the whole team, and the shop sells new seed types (39 plants, from Sunflower to Winter Melon), more lanes (up to all 5) and new lawn mowers. The waves never stop: every stage is 10 waves, and like the game's own Endless mode they get bigger and new kinds of zombies show up as you go. Host a Steam lobby and invite your friends (or they use "Join Game" on you, even while the game is running), or play over your home network by IP. Every plant, zombie, pea, sun drop and coin is the same for everyone. The rest of the game still works as normal, and your original install and saves aren't touched.

The zip contains an installer (PvZ-Multiplayer-Setup.exe) that finds your Plants vs. Zombies folder and sets Steam to start the mod, the raw mod files if you'd rather install it yourself, and a README explaining both. You need your own copy of Plants vs. Zombies (Game of the Year edition on Steam), and everyone needs the same version.
details: Up to 4 players, each walking the lawn as their own colour of Crazy Dave
Lawn Tycoon: start with 1 lane and the Peashooter, earn shared money from kills and buy seeds, lanes and mowers
Endless waves that scale up like the game's Endless mode
Shared sun, seed bank and money, and every plant, zombie and pea is synced
Join through Steam invites or "Join Game" (no port forwarding), even mid-game, or by IP on your home network
Installer exe + raw mod files + README in one zip
mods.changelog: 1.0.0: first public build. Up to 4 players, Lawn Tycoon endless co-op, Steam invites or LAN. Includes a one-click installer.

mods.name: SULFUR Multiplayer
mods.summary: Online co-op for 2–8 players, plus Sulf Arena: a competitive mode where up to 4 players build loadouts and fight each other. Join through Steam.
mods.description:
SULFUR Multiplayer lets you and your friends play SULFUR together over Steam. One player hosts and everyone else joins through a Steam invite or "Join Game" in the friends list, with no IP addresses or port forwarding. Everyone drops into the host's level and fights the same enemies, which go after every player and grow in number with each player who joins. Boss fights pull the whole party into the arena, loot, chests, doors and physics objects are shared, and the church stash and shops belong to the whole group. Other players show up as priests holding whatever weapon they have out, and you see their shots, reloads, grenades and scroll effects. Joining a friend never touches your own saves: you play on a separate character kept just for their game.

Sulf Arena is a competitive mode for up to 4 players. Everyone gets 5000 to build a loadout in their own church, where every vendor in the game is waiting, then you're dropped into a small arena and fight until one priest is left. The winner keeps their gear; everyone else starts over with more money each round (insured guns are kept). First to 5 round wins is the champion. Sulf Arena doesn't use a save at all.

How to install: download the zip and unzip it anywhere. Close SULFUR, then run SulfurMP-Setup.exe. If Windows says "Windows protected your PC", click "More info" and then "Run anyway".

The installer finds your SULFUR folder by itself (if it can't, click "Browse..." and pick the folder with Sulfur.exe in it). Click "Install". The first time, it downloads the official BepInEx mod loader, so you need an internet connection. Then start SULFUR from Steam as usual. To update, run the new installer and click "Reinstall".

To play: on the main menu press P and click "Host - pick a save", then invite friends from the P menu. Friends accept the Steam invite or use "Join Game". For Sulf Arena, press P on the main menu and click "Host Sulf Arena". Everyone needs the same version of the mod. The zip also has the raw mod files and a README if you'd rather install by hand.
details: Built for SULFUR 1.0
2–8 players, joined through Steam invites or "Join Game" (no port forwarding)
Sulf Arena: competitive PvP for up to 4 players — buy a loadout, fight until one is left, first to 5 round wins
Shared enemies that scale with the number of players, and every boss fight brings the whole party in
Shared loot, chests, doors, physics objects, church stash, shops and stamps
See other players' guns, shots, grenades, scroll effects and summons; statuses like fire and poison hit everyone
Your own saves are never touched when you join a friend
Installer exe + raw mod files + README in one zip
mods.changelog: Version 0.10.0: updated for SULFUR 1.0. Everyone needs this version to play together.

mods.name: Noita Multiplayer
mods.summary: Two-player online co-op in one shared, fully synced Noita world. Join through Steam or by IP.
mods.description:
Noita Multiplayer puts you and a friend in the same world at the same time: terrain, liquids, fire, enemies, bosses, items, physics objects, spells, perks, orbs, hearts and gold are all synced. Pick "Co-op: Host" or "Co-op: Join" in the New Game menu, or invite your friend through Steam and their game loads your world by itself — even if they're sitting on the main menu. If you die while your partner is alive (even as a polymorphed creature) you go down instead, and they can revive you.

The zip contains an installer (NoitaCoop_Installer.exe) that sets everything up, the raw mod folders if you'd rather install it yourself, and a README explaining both. Both players need the same version.
details: Shared world: terrain, water, fire, enemies, bosses, items and physics props stay in sync
Join through Steam invites (no port forwarding), even from the main menu, or by direct IP
Downed & revive (polymorphed too), shared perks, orbs, hearts and gold
Installer exe + raw mod folders + README in one zip
mods.changelog: 1.5.0: fixed enemies moving along with the players, bosses stay in sync (the host runs the fight), breaking a Holy Mountain sends the guardian after both players, killed enemies no longer come back, perks no longer reappear after one is taken, no more doubled Holy Mountain spells, and gold is shared between both players. Both players must update (1.4.x can't connect to 1.5.0). 1.4.1: crash fixes, and a polymorphed partner shows up as the creature they turned into.

mods.name: FTL: Faster Than Light Multiplayer
mods.summary: Crew one ship together—online co-op for up to 8 players, each controlling one crew member. Join through Steam or by IP.
mods.description:
FTL Co-op puts up to 8 players on the same ship. Each player controls one crew member and runs the controls of the room they're standing in: the pilot handles power, jumps and the star map, the gunner aims and fires, and the doors, drones, teleporter, cloaking, hacking and mind control each belong to whoever mans that room. Crew nobody controls are run by a smarter AI that mans stations, repairs, fights fires and boarders and heads to the medbay when hurt. Invite a Steam friend from FTL's main menu (no port forwarding), or join by IP.

The zip contains an installer (FTL-Coop-Install.exe) that rolls FTL back to 1.6.9 and sets everything up, the raw mod files if you'd rather install it yourself, and a README explaining both. Everyone needs the same version.
details: Up to 8 players share one ship, one crew member each
Room-based controls: piloting, weapons, drones, doors and more
Join through Steam invites (no port forwarding) or by direct IP
Installer exe + raw mod files + README in one zip
mods.changelog: 11.0.0: first public build (co-op mod version 11). Up to 8 players, Steam invites or IP, join or leave mid-run, vote to save and quit, smarter AI crew for unclaimed crew members. Needs FTL 1.6.9 - the installer rolls it back for you.
